query: How can I unlock my account if I entered the wrong password three times?

stage1_vector_only.doc: If your account is locked due to 3 failed login attempts, contact IT Support at extension 5555 to unlock it.
To reset your account password, navigate to Settings > Security and click 'Reset Password'. An email will be sent.
Security best practices recommend changing your password every 90 days to prevent unauthorized access.
Password policies require at least 12 characters, including uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and special symbols.
